The `/desk-context` pane shows what fills the context, how it filled during the session, and what each turn cost.

- The context bar is drawn in each category's own color, with free space as a thin line and the auto-compact buffer dashed, and each category row gets a bar of its own
- "Loaded into context" lists MCP tools by server (with how many load on demand), memory files, the skill listing (how many of the session's skills it lists) and custom agents, each group folded until you click it
- "This session" graphs how full the context was at the end of each turn, scaled to the highest point, with `┈` at the auto-compact height and `▲` where the conversation was compacted. It keeps what each turn end already reads for the context chip and asks nothing more; it starts over after `/reload-plugins` or when the window moves to another session, and its title says since when
- Cache shows how the last turn's input split between read from cache, written to cache and new, and the share read from cache over the turns in the graph; cost shows a bar per turn and the last turn's cost
- The breakdown is calculated when the pane opens and on `↻`, once each (it used to be calculated twice). A closed pane does no work, and an open one adds no calculation per turn
- The project has a homepage in `docs/`, and the demo in the README is recorded again with this version

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-asana@cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-slack@cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
